# Kebsik

> Kebsik is a single-player kebab shop management game for Android, currently available through a Google Play closed test.

The base gameplay works offline. Ads, purchases and optional feedback require internet. In-game time advances while the game is running; offline earnings are not offered. Optional purchases are one-time purchases. Ad removal covers interstitial ads; rewarded videos remain optional.
